title: Add institute phone number and address to public site contact areas

requirements.text: Ensure the website prominently displays the institute phone number and physical address (in addition to email) in public-facing contact areas using the existing editable contact content (pageId: "contact"). Specifically, the Admissions & Contact page contact card and the global footer must show phone and address values (not omit them) and render phone/email as clickable links (tel: / mailto:) when non-empty.
acceptanceCriteria: On /admissions, the Contact Information card shows Address and Phone lines sourced from useContactContent() and does not hide them.
In the footer Contact section, Phone and Address are displayed alongside Email and match the same values shown on /admissions.
If phone is present, it is rendered as a clickable tel: link; if email is present, it is rendered as a clickable mailto: link.
No edits are made to files under frontend/src/components/ui or other immutable paths.

requirements.text: Initialize a default "contact" page in backend content storage so phone/address/email are consistently available via getPage("contact") without requiring an admin save first. Use the existing frontend defaults (address, phone, email) as the initial values stored for this page.
acceptanceCriteria: A fresh deployment returns a non-null PageContent for getPage("contact").
The default stored contact page contains non-empty values for header (address), body (phone), and footer (email) matching the frontend default placeholders currently used.
Admin updates to pageId "contact" continue to persist and are reflected on the public site.

constraints: Backend must remain a single Motoko actor with all logic in backend/main.mo.
Do not modify files in frontend immutablePaths (including frontend/src/components/ui, frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.ts/tsx, frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts, frontend/src/main.tsx).
User-facing text must be in English.
nonGoals: Collecting or sending contact form submissions via email/SMS or any third-party messaging integration.
Adding maps, geolocation, or directions features.
Changing authentication/authorization behavior for the Admin page.
